title: October–November Raku Class
source_quote: For 577 six-week pottery class graduates: If you're also enrolled in the October–November Raku class and would like to explore Raku firing your polar bear, let Julie know when you arrive at class.
evidence_sentence: The pottery pages mention an October–November Raku class for six-week pottery graduates.

summary: A raku firing class for potters who have completed 577's six-week pottery course. Exact dates and registration details are not provided on the pages.
how_to_join: Contact 577 directly or ask during a pottery class.
